sections.heading: Two different roles, and it matters which one applies

items: For the website, our marketing, and your account data, we are the data controller: we decide why and how those data are processed.

For the DMARC reports you route to the service and everything derived from them, we act as data processor on your behalf: you remain the controller of that data. The terms of that processing are in our Data Processing Agreement.

Legal basis: our legitimate interest in a working, secure site (art. 6(1)(f)) and your consent for anything beyond that (art. 6(1)(a)).
When you contact us. The details you send us, to answer you. Legal basis: art. 6(1)(b) and (f).

When you use the service. Account data (name, email address, preferences, language, authentication identifiers), billing data, and audit records of significant actions. Legal basis: performance of the contract (art. 6(1)(b)) and our legal obligations (art. 6(1)(c)).

The DMARC reports themselves. Aggregate reports contain the IP addresses of the servers that sent email using your domain — which can be personal data of third parties. We process them only to produce the analysis, score, alerts and digests you asked for, as your processor, and never for our own purposes. Legal basis: your instructions as controller, under the DPA.

AI-generated commentary. If enabled for your plan, the digest may include a written comment produced by Anthropic. Only the domain data needed for that comment is sent. This is stated explicitly because it is the question customers ask most often.
We use a limited set of sub-processors, each for a specific purpose. The current list, with what each one receives, is published on our GDPR & DPA page.
Account data and report data are processed and stored in the European Union, on infrastructure operated by Aruba S.p.A. in Italy, with email delivery in the AWS eu-west-1 region.

Some sub-processors and the optional analytics and marketing services may transfer data to the United States, under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses. Where this applies it is stated in the sub-processor list and in the Cookie Policy.

blocks.html: Sentinely ingests DMARC aggregate reports and provides analysis, a protection score, alerts, digests, exportable reports and a read-only public API.

Sentinely is an analysis tool. It does not send, filter or reroute your email, and it does not publish or modify your DNS records. Recommendations are informative: acting on them is your decision and your responsibility.
Some free tools on our website — such as the email header analyser — are provided without an account, as-is, and retain nothing: what you paste is analysed and discarded.
You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide, for the security of your credentials, and for the activity of the users you invite to your organisation.
You agree to use Sentinely only for domains you are authorised to manage, and not to misuse, disrupt or attempt to gain unauthorised access to the service.

Sharing reports by email. The service lets you email a report to recipients you choose, sent from our sending domain. You are responsible for having a legitimate reason to contact those recipients. Because those messages leave from our domain, abuse damages the email deliverability of every other customer. We apply per-send limits and rate limits, we keep a record of each send, and we may suspend this feature — or the account — where we detect abuse.

Plans are described at sign-up. Prices are in EUR and exclude VAT. Payments are handled by Stripe or PayPal, depending on the method you choose at checkout; we never see or store your full payment credentials. Annual billing is charged as ten monthly instalments.

A free plan and trial periods may be offered, with reduced limits that we may change for future periods. Reaching a limit restricts the corresponding feature; it never deletes data that has already been collected.
You retain all rights to your data. We process the personal data contained in your DMARC reports as your processor, under our Privacy Policy and DPA. Retention follows the period of your plan.
You may permanently delete a domain and all of its data at any time. That deletion is irreversible.

We aim for continuous availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted service. Maintenance, third-party failures and force majeure may cause interruptions. Support is provided by email at info@sentinely.eu.
We may suspend an account for non-payment, for breach of these Terms, or where required by law. Where circumstances allow, we give notice first.

The service is provided "as is". To the extent permitted by law, our liability is limited as set out in this section — *[da completare con l'avvocato: massimale, esclusione dei danni indiretti, deroghe imperative]*.
We may update these Terms. Substantial changes are notified at least 30 days in advance, and continued use after they take effect constitutes acceptance.

blocks.html: Cookies are small text files that the sites you visit store on your device. Some are necessary for a site to work; others are placed only if you agree to them.

No statistics cookie is placed before you agree. On your first visit a banner asks you what you want. Until you answer, this site stores nothing at all: the statistics script is not loaded, not even in the background, and no request leaves your browser towards it.

Refusing is exactly as easy as accepting — one button, side by side, same size. If you refuse, nothing is loaded and nothing more is asked of you. You can change your mind at any time through Cookie preferences at the bottom of any page.
Once you have made a choice, one cookie of ours records it, so we do not ask again:
Only if you accept statistics, our Matomo instance sets these:

rows: Groups the requests of one visit together

blocks.html: If you refuse, none of the Matomo cookies is ever written.

Separately from cookies, your light or dark theme choice is kept in your browser's local storage under theme. It never leaves your device and is not sent with any request. Clearing your browsing data removes it.

sections.heading: Statistics: Matomo, and we host it ourselves

blocks.html: We use Matomo to understand which pages are read and how people arrive at them. It runs on our own infrastructure at analytics.purpletech.it: the statistics it collects reach no third party, because Matomo is software we operate, not a service we send your data to. Nothing about your visit is sold, shared or used to build an advertising profile.
We ask for your consent all the same. These are statistics cookies, not technical ones, and we would rather ask than assume.

sections.heading: The one third-party script: the check on our forms

blocks.html: The contact form and the affiliate form load Cloudflare Turnstile, the check that tells a person apart from an automated script. It runs on those two pages only, for the sole purpose of letting the form be submitted, and it is not a statistics or advertising tool: it measures nothing about you and builds no profile. Without it the forms would be filled by bots within days, so it is a security measure needed to deliver a service you asked for — which is why it does not require consent.
Turnstile is provided by Cloudflare, Inc., which also delivers this website.

When you choose, we keep a record of it: a random identifier (the same one held in the sntly_consent cookie), the choice itself, the version of this policy, the moment, your browser identification, and a keyed hash of your IP address — never the address itself. We keep it for 24 months, because art. 7(1) GDPR requires the controller to be able to demonstrate that consent was given. This record is never used to profile you and is never linked to advertising.

app.sentinely.eu — the product you sign in to — uses only technical cookies: the ones that keep you signed in and remember your preferences. It carries no statistics or advertising cookie and loads no third-party tracking script, which is why it shows no banner: there is nothing there to consent to. Technical cookies require no consent (art. 122 of the Italian Privacy Code, and its European equivalent, exempt them), but they do require that we tell you they exist — which is what this section does.

sections.heading: How to control what is stored

blocks.html: Use Cookie preferences at the bottom of any page to change or withdraw your choice. Withdrawing deletes the statistics cookies we know of and reloads the page, so that a script already running is actually stopped — a withdrawal that leaves it running would not be one.
Every browser also lets you inspect, delete and block cookies and local storage on your own.
To exercise your rights over your personal data, see the Privacy Policy or write to info@sentinely.eu.

I dati di account e i dati dei report sono trattati e conservati nell'Unione Europea, su infrastruttura gestita da Aruba S.p.A. in Italia, con l'invio delle email nella region AWS eu-west-1.

blocks.html: I cookie sono piccoli file di testo che i siti che visiti salvano sul tuo dispositivo. Alcuni sono necessari al funzionamento del sito; altri vengono installati solo se acconsenti.

Nessun cookie di statistica viene installato prima del tuo consenso. Alla prima visita un banner ti chiede come vuoi procedere. Finché non rispondi questo sito non salva assolutamente nulla: lo script delle statistiche non viene caricato, nemmeno in secondo piano, e nessuna richiesta parte dal tuo browser verso di esso.

Rifiutare è esattamente facile quanto accettare: un pulsante, accanto all'altro, della stessa dimensione. Se rifiuti non viene caricato nulla e non ti viene chiesto altro. Puoi cambiare idea quando vuoi da Preferenze cookie, in fondo a ogni pagina.
Una volta che hai scelto, un nostro cookie registra la scelta, così non te la richiediamo:

rows: Ricorda la tua scelta sui cookie

blocks.html: Soltanto se accetti le statistiche, la nostra istanza Matomo installa questi:

rows: Raggruppa le richieste di una stessa visita

blocks.html: Se rifiuti, nessun cookie di Matomo viene mai scritto.

A parte i cookie, la tua scelta fra tema chiaro e scuro viene conservata nella memoria locale del browser sotto la voce theme. Non lascia mai il tuo dispositivo e non viene inviata con alcuna richiesta. Cancellando i dati di navigazione sparisce.

sections.heading: Le statistiche: Matomo, e lo ospitiamo noi

blocks.html: Usiamo Matomo per capire quali pagine vengono lette e come ci si arriva. Gira su infrastruttura nostra, all'indirizzo analytics.purpletech.it: le statistiche che raccoglie non raggiungono nessuna terza parte, perché Matomo è un software che gestiamo, non un servizio a cui inviamo i tuoi dati. Nulla della tua visita viene venduto, condiviso o usato per costruire un profilo pubblicitario.
Ti chiediamo comunque il consenso: sono cookie statistici, non tecnici, e preferiamo chiedere piuttosto che dare per scontato.

sections.heading: L'unico script di terze parti: il controllo sui moduli

blocks.html: Il modulo di contatto e quello per gli affiliati caricano Cloudflare Turnstile, il controllo che distingue una persona da uno script automatico. Funziona soltanto su quelle due pagine e al solo scopo di permettere l'invio del modulo, e non è uno strumento di statistica né di pubblicità: non misura nulla di te e non costruisce alcun profilo. Senza, i moduli sarebbero riempiti dai bot nel giro di pochi giorni: è quindi una misura di sicurezza necessaria a fornire un servizio che hai richiesto, e per questo non richiede consenso.
Turnstile è fornito da Cloudflare, Inc., che distribuisce anche questo sito.

Quando scegli, conserviamo la prova della scelta: un identificativo casuale (lo stesso del cookie sntly_consent), la scelta stessa, la versione di questa informativa, il momento, il tuo browser e un hash con chiave del tuo indirizzo IP — mai l'indirizzo in chiaro. Lo conserviamo per 24 mesi, perché l'art. 7(1) GDPR impone al titolare di poter dimostrare che il consenso è stato prestato. Questo registro non serve mai a profilarti e non viene mai collegato a finalità pubblicitarie.

app.sentinely.eu — il prodotto in cui accedi — utilizza soltanto cookie tecnici: quelli che ti tengono autenticato e ricordano le tue preferenze. Non contiene alcun cookie statistico o di marketing e non carica alcuno script di tracciamento di terze parti: per questo non mostra alcun banner, non ci sarebbe nulla a cui prestare consenso. I cookie tecnici non richiedono consenso (l'art. 122 del Codice privacy, e il suo equivalente europeo, li esentano), ma richiedono che ti sia detto che esistono: è ciò che fa questa sezione.

sections.heading: Come controllare ciò che viene salvato

blocks.html: Usa Preferenze cookie, in fondo a ogni pagina, per cambiare o revocare la tua scelta. La revoca cancella i cookie di statistica che conosciamo e ricarica la pagina, così uno script già avviato viene davvero fermato: una revoca che lo lasciasse girare non sarebbe tale.
Ogni browser permette inoltre di consultare, cancellare e bloccare cookie e memoria locale per conto proprio.
Per esercitare i tuoi diritti sui dati personali vedi l'Informativa sulla privacy o scrivi a info@sentinely.eu.
